source_semantics: 23-Nov specification, ordinary native/walker execution, typed value-record and dynamic-binding model
implemented_scope: 33 finite functional/collection operations plus reusable internal engines; not a claim that every foreign standard-library feature is now covered
deliberate_differences: Finite eager Arrays do not reproduce Haskell lazy/infinite lists or consuming Python/Rust iterators.
cycle requires a finite count; replicate returns a record Array.
unzip uses the existing named FxPair protocol, not an arbitrary two-field row without admission.
set results have stable first-occurrence order and eliminate duplicates; difference is set difference, not list multiset subtraction.
adjoin preserves source identity when present; its fresh-array absent case does not claim linked-list tail sharing.
The existing callback failure envelope is documented; collect consumes Stop and preserves other producer names/payloads in FxCallFailure.
operator_contract: No prefix-only operator kind is introduced. Any operand wrapper must use ordinary OPERANDS_TEMPLATE left/right and the existing common prefix/infix rules. This file adds ordinary receivers, not parser special cases.
